paper_id: PACE_ Improving Prompt with Actor-Critic Editing for Large Language Model__oa_W4386081037
title: PACE: Improving Prompt with Actor-Critic Editing for Large Language Model
motivation: 人类编写的提示词质量差异大,LLM对提示词敏感导致性能波动,改进提示词需大量人工试错
problem_framing: 将提示工程视为策略优化问题,通过LLM作为Actor和Critic迭代优化提示词
key_insight: prompt如同policy,利用LLM双重角色(执行+批判)形成闭环反馈实现自动编辑
method_signature: PACE迭代算法:Actor执行prompt生成response,Critic评估提供反馈,聚合n个反馈更新prompt
evaluation_criteria: 在24个Instruction Induction任务和21个Big-Bench任务上验证,采用Accuracy等实际评测指标
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: PACE处理中高难度问题有效,但面对极复杂问题时建议人机协作,以及闭源模型API限制导致无法访问概率
evidence_for_taste: drafting initial prompts is relatively straightforward
real challenge is refining and optimizing these drafts
it is relatively straightforward for humans to draft
the real challenge is refining and optimizing
critic possesses a slightly higher significance
PACE is efficient in handling medium to low-difficulty problems
for highly complex problems, we firmly believe in the power of human-machine collaboration
thinking_moves: 将prompt editing与RL的actor-critic范式类比,借用现成算法框架
指出领域忽视的second stage(改进阶段),重新定位问题重要性
通过消融实验区分Actor和Critic各自的贡献度
把提示词质量从best/worst角度量化,构建系统化评测基线
